Distinct mature masculine and feminine faces, neither chibi nor childlike. Maintain exact identity and cranial volume between angles. Render as carefully authored high-resolution PIXEL ART with visibly deliberate clean pixel clusters, around 160 pixels per head before enlargement, 12-16 harmonious warm skin colours, larger unified light/shadow areas, restrained highlights, no random dithering, no thick waxy rings around eyes, no metallic shine. Simple pale ivory background and balanced spacing. Orthographic study views with consistent lighting and scale. This board is an art-direction reference, not a labelled scientific diagram. No text, letters, measurements, arrows, watermarks or decorative elements.
